C0390.title: SEC Suspends Trading in 379 Dormant Shell Companies in a Single Day
C0390.summary: The SEC intensified its crackdown by suspending trading in 379 dormant shell companies in a single day, setting a historic record. These companies had long failed to disclose information and remained inactive, representing typical zombie firms.

references.title: SEC Microcap Fraud-Fighting Initiative Expels 379 Dormant Shell
